reviewNotes: Reviewed all 1028 distinct exported keys across 189 cards against data/golden-grammar.json source furigana and grammatical context. Converted topic/contrast は and conjunction または to わ by exact key and explicitly reviewed occurrence positions; preserved lexical はなす/はなし/はなして, はじめる, はやい, はれる, はず, はずかしい, はっきり, はっけん, はいけい, はたらく, はんい, はんだん, はんたい, はんのう, ごはん. Reviewed every directional へ -> え, retaining lexical へんか, へんとう, へや, へんしん, たいへん. Every を is the object particle -> お, including quotations. Corrected 気に入る from source きにはいる to きにいる, verified against Japan Foundation Marugoto vocabulary (https://marugoto.jpf.go.jp/assets/docs/download/intermediate2/MarugotoIntermediate2VocabularyList_VN.pdf). Normalized grammar terms ます形 from ますがた to ますけい (https://www.kyozai.jpf.go.jp/kyozai/classroom/waiwai/home/ja/render.do) and た形 from source たがた/たかたち to たけい only in the grammatical term, preserving ordinary かたち (https://www.kanjifumi.jp/keyword/takei/). Explicitly read unconverted 嫌い as きらい and 間に as あいだに; N placeholder as えぬ. Converted katakana preserving long vowels and gemination; added final punctuation to bare fragments. Distinct display labels and lookup keys unchanged. Nova speed 0.85. Text review only; no audible pitch-accent or articulation verification. Updated generation speeds: sentence/dialogue question prompts (including cloze prompts) and full explanations use entry speed 1.0; standalone answer words, grammar fragments, and combined choice lists retain default 0.85. Exact reviewed hiragana inputs unchanged.
